6. **Consult a Professional**: A financial advisor or attorney specializing in estate planning can provide personalized advice based on your unique circumstances.

7. **Keep Records**: Maintain detailed records of all transactions related to your estate plan. This includes gifts made, distributions made, and any changes to your will or trusts.

8. **Update Regularly**: Estate laws change frequently, so review your will periodically to ensure it remains current and effective.
